faq.q: Can I build a house on vacant ALR land in Abbotsford?
faq.a: Under the ALC frame, generally one principal residence of 500 m² or less total floor area, with no more than 1,000 m² of fill placed for its construction; a secondary suite only inside that principal residence; and one additional detached residence up to 90 m² (properties of 40 ha or less) or 186 m² (over 40 ha). City zoning must also permit the residence, and anything larger or more numerous needs ALC approval. The live page's FAQ answer omits the fill limit and the additional-residence tiers.
